description: Annual County Road Related Expenditures is a dataset listed in State of Washington open data portal (data.wa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Washington. Annual county road related expenditures, rounded to the nearest thousand. Each county's road fund can be used for a variety of construction, repair, maintenance and improvement projects on county roads and bridges, as specified in RCW 36.82.070. The total expenditures include federal, RAP and CAPP program expenditures. Coverage: Washington State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are expenditures, county, roads, transportation, county roads. The table has 14 columns. Attribution on the portal: County Road Administration Board (CRAB). The portal shows 2026-06-24 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-wa-gov-portal.
